promptLines: Primary request: Create a polished anime visual-novel background for “Signal at Blue Hour,” set at a seaside radio observatory during meteor-watch week.

Scene/backdrop: an empty open-air observatory control terrace on a coastal cliff at blue hour; large radio-dish silhouettes and antenna structures, distant ocean horizon, glass-and-metal control room windows, tidy consoles and railings, windswept coastal grass at the edges, one or two subtle meteor trails high in the sky.
Subject: environment only; absolutely no people, characters, silhouettes, portraits, reflections of people, or human figures.

Style/medium: premium contemporary Japanese visual-novel background illustration; clean architectural drawing, soft cel-painted surfaces, delicate atmospheric gradients, high production value, original design.

Composition/framing: wide cinematic 16:9 establishing view at human eye level; leave a calm uncluttered character-readable zone in the right-middle foreground and keep the lower quarter compositionally quiet for dialogue UI; retain depth and a strong ocean vista.
Lighting/mood: tranquil blue hour moving into first stars; indigo and teal ambient light with restrained warm amber instrument glow; romantic but grounded, inviting, tasteful 15+ tone.
Color palette: deep indigo, muted teal, cyan haze, ivory highlights, restrained amber practical lights.
Constraints: coherent perspective; usable as a game background behind a transparent upper-body character sprite; no text, labels, logos, signatures, borders, UI, speech bubbles, or watermark.
Avoid: characters of any kind; school imagery; photorealism; 3D-render look; excessive bloom; clutter in the sprite/UI zones; illegible pseudo-text.
